submission.justification: Absorber-F3 gives the best simulated resolution, 3.09% at 4 mm. The scan was 2, 4 and 6 mm, and 4 mm was best. At 4 mm F1 gives 3.90% and F2 gives 5.34%. The residual dose constraint (<=20 uSv/h at 1 m after one week) could not be checked. None of the project documents contain activation or dose data, and the simulation tool only returns resolution. This is a hard requirement, so the recommendation is conditional. Before F3 is committed, its dose must be verified with an activation calculation. If F3 fails, the fallback is F1 (3.90% at 4 mm), and F2 would be the last choice. Only 2, 4 and 6 mm were scanned for F3, so the optimum could lie between those points. Thicknesses above 6 mm were not simulated.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F3 at 4 mm gives 3.09%, the best of the points simulated. F3 was 3.63% at 2 mm and 3.31% at 6 mm. F1 was 3.90% and F2 was 5.34% at 4 mm.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week <= 20 uSv/h (hard)
requirements.evidence: No document gives dose or activation data for any candidate, and the simulation tool reports only resolution. This needs a separate activation study.

requirements.requirement: Material is one of the three candidates
